data.body:
AC2 rewritten and ticked; statelessness recorded in the ADRs (operator approval 2026-08-28).

**AC2 was rewritten, not reinterpreted.** The original text asked the retire path to either
preserve routing to the old container for the life of its sessions, or to stop describing a
graceful drain that cannot protect sticky sessions. The operator decision of 2026-08-27 —
"STATELESS is the approved fix", landed as commit `4af91ec2e799` — dissolved that premise: the
MCP HTTP transport mints no `Mcp-Session-Id`, so there is no sticky session to preserve or to
mis-describe. The criterion now reads: the retire path's logs accurately describe what SIGTERM
drains (in-flight operations), and no log implies session protection. The rationale is recorded
inline in the criterion so a future reader sees a scope change rather than a criterion that
always said this.

**Verified true against the current script before ticking** (`infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, no
edit made):

- retire: `mcp retire: 'docker stop --time ${MCP_STOP_GRACE}' $1 in background (graceful SIGTERM
  self-drain; never rm -f a serving container)`
- cutover: `mcp cutover complete: /mcp upstream now 127.0.0.1:${mcp_newport} (deploy DONE; not
  waiting on in-flight drain)`
- reap: `mcp retire: reaped exited $n (port ${p:-?} freed)`
- over-cap marker: `... NOT forcing a kill (containers still draining/holding ports)`

All four describe in-flight operations / container lifecycle. The string `session` does not
appear anywhere in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`. No log implies session protection, so the
criterion holds with no code change.

**The durable half — statelessness is now in the ADRs.** It was previously recorded only on this
ticket and in a code comment, while ADR 0104 section 2 still narrated blue-green in terms that
made sticky-session orphaning read as tolerated. Dated amendments added to:

- `docs/adr/0104-mcp-on-box.md` section 2 — the server holds no per-container session state, so
  the pointer swap cannot orphan a client session and the retire drain covers in-flight ops only.
- `docs/adr/0079-autodeploy-on-box-timer.md` — a paired amendment of the same date, matching the
  existing 2026-08-24 amendment's style and placement.

Both cite this ticket and commit `4af91ec2e799`. Neither rewrites the original decision text.
